body:
Actis has won Road Deal of the Year at the 2026 LatinFinance Project & Infrastructure Finance Awards, for its US$1.6 billion acquisition of a 416km Colombian toll road portfolio from Sacyr, now operating as Vialtis.

The deal, financed through Actis’ Long Life Infrastructure Fund 2, launched Actis’ first Latin American toll roads platform and was led by our Long Life Infrastructure team under Davi Carvalho Mota. Diego Novoa had the pleasure of collecting the award on Actis’ behalf.

Thank you to LatinFinance for the recognition.

Actis was presented with the Road Deal of the Year award from LatinFinance at the LatinFinance Project & Infrastructure Finance Awards on 1 October 2026. Actis did not provide any compensation to take part in such awards. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Nothing herein constitutes a guarantee, projection, or prediction. There can be no guarantee that transactions with similar characteristics will be available to Actis.
